verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS email platform like MailerSend, but the evidence pack never documents one inside the product. The only AI-related item describes connecting MailerSend to external AI tools such as Claude or Gemini. That is an integration with outside assistants, not an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
